items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This study examines faunal assemblages from paired semisubterranean houses and middens at 10 Early Inuit sites spanning the North American Arctic (ca. 1200–1500 
                    <jats:sc>ce</jats:sc>
                    ) to evaluate whether local resource bases or other factors primarily structure zooarchaeological variability. Using taxonomic, taphonomic, and multivariate analyses, we compare assemblage composition, diversity, and bone modifications to assess patterns of site formation and human behavior. Results indicate that variability is greatest among sites rather than between houses and middens, with local resource availability emerging as the dominant driver of assemblage composition. While houses generally exhibit higher taxonomic diversity and more burned bone than middens, likely reflecting food preparation and consumption, differences in fragmentation, weathering, and butchery marks are inconsistent and not associated with excavation methods. Canid gnawing correlates with reduced fish remains, particularly in middens, highlighting a significant postdepositional process. Overall, house and midden assemblages from the same site cluster closely by taxonomic composition, suggesting that either context broadly represents site‐level economies. These findings underscore the primacy of regional ecological factors in shaping Early Inuit subsistence and demonstrate that single‐context faunal analyses can reliably inform interpretations of Arctic economic systems.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《北美北极地区早期因纽特遗址房屋与贝丘的动物考古学：探究组合构成模式》：研究比较10处早期因纽特遗址成对半地穴房屋与贝丘的动物遗存，分析组合构成、多样性与骨骼改造，评估当地资源基础等因素如何塑造动物考古变异。
items.title: Zooarchaeology of Houses and Middens: Investigating Patterns of Assemblage Composition at Early Inuit Sites Across the North American Arctic

items.abstract: The Mongolian Plateau is characterized by an arid, highly seasonal, and low-productivity environment, conditions long assumed to sustain nomadic pastoralism as the predominant lifeway. However, recent archaeological discoveries in the southern plateau reveal early sedentism during the early Holocene that predate agro-pastoralism, prompting the fundamental question of how these societies achieved sedentism under these ecological constraints, particularly what subsistence strategies supported them. The Yumin Culture represents the early sedentary community in the region, signaling the transition into the Neolithic on the southern Mongolian Plateau. In this study, we reconstructed the subsistence resources exploited by the inhabitants of the Yumin site (dated back to 8600–7400 cal BP) using sedimentary ancient DNA (sedaDNA) metagenomics from the archaeological deposits. Our data reveal a broad-spectrum economy comprising diverse wild ungulates (e.g., Cervus , Bos , Equus ), omnivores (e.g., Sus ); small and fast-reproducing animals such as hares ( Lepus ), and a wide variety of wild plants potentially as food resources, including edible fruits, nuts, grass seeds, and underground storage organs, complemented by a small fraction of millet ( Setaria italica ). Further integrated with paleoclimatic, past natural vegetation and hydrological reconstructions, our data reveal the human–environment interactions underlying early sedentism on the southern Mongolian Plateau, showing that early Holocene climatic amelioration created resource-rich ecotones that were strategically exploited through diversified foraging and resource intensification, thereby stabilizing food supplies and enabling permanent settlement without reliance on agriculture.
items.summary: 《沉积古DNA揭示蒙古高原南部广谱生计促进了早期定居》：研究利用考古沉积物中的沉积古DNA宏基因组学，重建了裕民遗址（距今约8600至7400年）居民所利用的生计资源，发现其经济涵盖多种野生有蹄类、杂食动物、野兔及多种野生植物，并辅以少量粟，结合古气候、古植被与水文重建，揭示了早期全新世气候改善所创造的资源丰富生态过渡带如何通过多样化觅食与资源强化被策略性…
items.title: Broad-spectrum subsistence facilitated early sedentism in the southern Mongolian Plateau revealed by sedimentary ancient DNA

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Hippopotamuses are key palaeoenvironmental indicators in African Pleistocene ecosystems due to their ecological dependence on permanent water bodies and their frequent representation in the fossil record. This study examines dental anomalies in
                    <jats:italic>Hippopotamus</jats:italic>
                    cf.
                    <jats:italic>gorgops</jats:italic>
                    from several localities in Bed II of Olduvai Gorge (Tanzania), dated to ca. 1.7–1.3 Ma. A total of 107 dental elements (incisors, canines, premolars, and molars) were analyzed to document these anomalies and evaluate their behavioral and environmental implications. Dental anomalies are concentrated exclusively in the anterior dentition, affecting 58.9% of the examined incisors and canines (
                    <jats:italic>n</jats:italic>
                     = 33 of 56), while premolars and molars show no pathological alterations. Several upper canines display subluxation and malocclusion associated with abnormal growth and atypical wear patterns, consistent with traumatic displacement during life. Biometric comparisons with extant
                    <jats:italic>Hippopotamus amphibius</jats:italic>
                    suggest that these specimens likely correspond to males, supporting an interpretation linked to aggressive intraspecific interactions similar to those observed in extant common hippopotamuses. In addition, various teeth exhibit enamel hypoplasia. Recurrent linear enamel hypoplasia (LEH) indicates repeated episodes of physiological stress during tooth development. The spacing of LEH bands in one well‐preserved canine suggests a higher frequency of stress episodes than previously reported for European Early Pleistocene hippopotamuses (
                    <jats:italic>Hippopotamus antiquus</jats:italic>
                    ). These defects likely reflect seasonal environmental fluctuations affecting water availability or vegetation productivity/phenology in the Olduvai Basin during this part of the Early Pleistocene. Overall, the results provide new insights into the behavior of
                    <jats:italic>H.</jats:italic>
                    cf.
                    <jats:italic>gorgops</jats:italic>
                    and support the presence of recurrent environmental stress in Olduvai Bed II ecosystems during the Oldowan‐Acheulean transition.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《奥杜威第二层更新世非洲河马的牙齿异常》：研究分析了坦桑尼亚奥杜威峡谷第二层约170万至130万年前河马化石的107件牙齿元素，发现牙齿异常仅集中于前部齿列，上犬齿存在半脱位与咬合不正，可能反映雄性间攻击行为，而反复出现的线性釉质发育不全则指示牙齿发育期间经历过多次生理应激，值得阅读以了解奥杜威盆地早期更新世环境波动及奥杜威-阿舍利过渡期的生态压力。
items.title:
Dental anomalies in Pleistocene African hippopotamuses from Olduvai Bed
                    <scp>II</scp>

items.summary: 《北海南部中更新世地层的新年代序列》：该研究为北海南部中更新世地层建立新的年代序列，值得阅读以了解这一区域地层年代框架的更新。
items.title: New chronologies for the Middle Pleistocene formations within the southern North Sea

items.abstract: Squamate (lizard and snake) exploitation provides a rarely documented window into human dietary flexibility at the end of the Pleistocene. This study analyzes over three millennia of squamate remains from el-Wad Terrace (Israel), revealing that large-bodied snakes and lizards formed a substantial and consistent part of Natufian subsistence. Repeated evidence of butchery on snake vertebrae indicates regular consumption across all occupation phases. Shifts in squamate abundance and bone modification patterns correspond to shifts in site-use intensity and the relative contribution of human and animal predators to archaeofaunal deposition. Species-based habitat weighting indicates a broadly stable Mediterranean maquis environment, where detected environmental shifts would not substantially alter local squamate abundance, demonstrating that variation in squamate use is unlikely to have resulted from environmental forcing. In the regional record, Natufian herpetofaunal assemblages cluster together, demonstrating human foraging choices and contrasting with those of older Paleolithic sites. In the latter, herpetofauna is far less abundant, taxonomically structured by geography, and includes more diverse and smaller-bodied taxa. Striving to understand the socioeconomic circumstances that contributed to relying on squamates for food, we assess their prey ranking by accounting for body size, agility, and the risks associated with handling different taxa. We found that high- and medium-ranked species were consistently targeted despite fluctuations in habitation intensity, suggesting squamate resilience. These results uncover the long-term role of reptiles in emerging sedentary lifeways and possibly early human impact on local reptile communities.
items.summary: 《纳图夫采集者三千年的蜥蜴与蛇类消费》：该研究分析以色列el-Wad Terrace遗址逾三千年的鳞龙类遗存，发现大型蛇与蜥蜴构成纳图夫生计中稳定且可观的部分，蛇椎骨上反复出现的屠宰痕迹表明各居住阶段均有规律食用，且鳞龙类利用变化并非环境驱动，值得阅读以了解爬行动物在新兴定居生活方式中的长期角色及早期人类对当地爬行动物群落的可能影响。
items.title: Three millennia of lizard and snake consumption by Natufian foragers
items.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Since the publication of our 2016 review mapping the Stone Age of Mozambique (Gonçalves et al., 2016), Stone Age archaeological research in the country has intensified significantly. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of 654 Stone Age sites, including 272 newly documented sites. The recent discoveries in a total of more than 400 sites, discovered primarily through systematic survey campaigns between 2010 and 2025, represent an important increase over the 250 sites known prior to 2010, fundamentally transforming our understanding of prehistoric occupation patterns in southeastern Africa. Our analysis examines altitudinal distribution, clustering, and regional settlement patterns across the Early Stone Age (ESA), Middle Stone Age (MSA), and Late Stone Age (LSA). Analysis reveals significant elevation differences between chronological periods, with ESA sites at lowest elevations, MSA at highest, and LSA intermediate. Multicomponent sites occupy significantly lower elevations than sites with only MSA assemblages, suggesting persistent landscape advantages at low-elevation locations such as river floodplains and coastlines. The extended analysis demonstrates that 45.8% of all sites contain MSA evidence when multicomponent assemblages are included, revealing MSA as the dominant phase and indicating maximum territorial expansion during this period. Clustering patterns intensify progressively from ESA (60% highly clustered) through MSA (76%) to LSA (81%), suggesting evolution from extensive mobility to intensive landscape use. Provincial analysis reveals four distinct settlement zones: Maputo, Niassa, and Gaza Provinces are dominated by MSA occupations, while the Sofala Province is dominated by LSA coastal plain occupation. Also relevant are the very common multiple component sites in the Maputo province. These findings show that survey results, including mainly open-air sites, are (1) an important source of information to better understand the Stone Age, (2) significantly enhance our understanding of prehistoric human behavioral variability in Mozambique and southeastern Africa, and (3) provide crucial data for testing hypotheses about the emergence and dispersal of early
                    <jats:italic>Homo sapiens</jats:italic>
                    .
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《莫桑比克石器时代景观：十年考古研究》：该研究综合分析654处石器时代遗址，其中272处为新记录，涵盖早、中、晚石器时代，考察海拔分布、聚集模式与区域定居格局，揭示中石器时代为优势阶段及从广泛流动到密集用地的发展，为理解东南部非洲史前人类行为变异与早期智人扩散提供关键数据。
items.title: Mozambique Stone Age Landscape: A Decade of Archaeological Research

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Understanding hunting strategies in Upper Paleolithic contexts remains challenging due to the complex relationships between prey behavior, environmental conditions, and human decision‐making. Addressing these dynamics requires integrating archeozoological, geospatial, and geochemical proxies capable of capturing demographic patterns, landscape accessibility, and seasonal environmental signals. This study examines the Magdalenian level 2b of Chaves Cave (Huesca, Spain), dated to ca. 15.7–15.0 ka cal BP, through a combined analysis of mortality profiles and stable isotope sequences (δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O and δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C) in
                    <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                      <jats:italic>Capra pyrenaica</jats:italic>
                    </jats:styled-content>
                    . Age‐at‐death profiles were reconstructed using multiple classification systems, while sequential isotopic analysis was conducted on third molars to investigate seasonality, diet, and mobility. Mortality profiles consistently show a predominance of late juveniles and young adults, together with the absence of neonates, indicating a seasonal bias in the accumulation. Isotopic results reveal sinusoidal δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O patterns reflecting seasonal environmental variation and δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C values consistent with a C3‐based diet. Modeling of δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O sequences indicates a restricted birth season, while the combined modeling of δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O and δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C sequences shows a consistent temporal offset between both signals, suggesting seasonal shifts in environmental and dietary conditions. Landscape accessibility analysis further evaluates the relationship between the site and surrounding topographic features potentially relevant to ibex movement. The integration of these proxies supports a model of recurrent hunting episodes structured within a restricted seasonal window, likely occurring after the birth season when herds included individuals of optimal age classes. The isotopic signal is consistent with short‐range seasonal mobility along altitudinal gradients within a coherent ecological system. Together, these results indicate flexible but structured hunting strategies, closely linked to the seasonal dynamics of ibex populations and the topographic configuration of the pre‐Pyrenean landscape. This study highlights the potential of combining mortality profiles and intra‐tooth isotope analysis to refine interpretations of subsistence strategies, seasonality, and mobility in Paleolithic hunter‐gatherer contexts.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《马格德林时期的狩猎策略与猎物利用组织：基于西班牙韦斯卡查韦斯洞穴死亡剖面与稳定同位素的综合研究》：该研究结合死亡年龄剖面与牙齿序列稳定同位素分析，重建查韦斯洞穴约15.7至15.0千年前马格德林期层位中西班牙野山羊的狩猎季节、食性与移动模式，并评估遗址周边地形可达性，为理解旧石器时代狩猎采集者的生计策略、季节性与流动性提供了多指标整合的案例。
items.title: Hunting Strategies and Game Exploitation Organization in the Magdalenian: An Integrated Approach Based on Mortality Profiles and Stable Isotopes at Chaves Cave (Huesca, Spain)

items.abstract: This work examines the interaction between humans and animals in urban environments in north-eastern Iberia from the Roman period to the end of the Middle Ages. We present a zooarchaeological study of the faunal remains found in Sotstinent Navarro, Barcelona, an archaeological site excavated as part of a rescue project. The zooarchaeological evidence presented and analysed here provides insight into the diet and provisioning of the city over time, focussing on three time periods: Late Roman and Late Antiquity (3rd-7th c.), the High Middle Ages (8th-12th c.), and the Late Middle Ages (13th-15th c.). Zooarchaeological data are complemented by biomolecular analyses, both Zooarchaeology by Mass Spectrometry (ZooMS) and stable carbon and nitrogen isotope analyses, focussing on caprines and equids. While equid results are inconclusive, the analysis of caprines provides new insights into sheep and goat livestock management. Caprines, especially sheep, became the predominant taxon, with a specialisation in their management as a meat resource detected, particularly evident in the Late Middle Ages.
items.summary: 《从罗马郊区到中世纪城市：西班牙巴塞罗那Sotstinent Navarro动物遗存的动物考古学研究——以山羊和馬科动物为例》：该研究分析巴塞罗那遗址出土动物遗存，结合质谱动物考古与稳定同位素分析，探讨罗马至中世纪城市饮食与供给，聚焦山羊和馬科动物，揭示绵羊逐渐成为主要肉食来源及晚期中世纪专业化管理，可供动物考古与历史城市研究参考。
items.title: From Roman suburbium to medieval city: zooarchaeological approach to Sotstinent Navarro faunal assemblages (Barcelona, Spain). Caprines and equids as a case study

items.summary: 《追踪复杂古代食物网中的个体饮食选择：城市猫的批量胶原蛋白与化合物特异性稳定同位素综合分析》：该研究以城市猫为对象，结合批量胶原蛋白与化合物特异性稳定同位素分析，追踪其在复杂古代食物网中的个体饮食选择，适合关注稳定同位素方法、历史动物食性及城市考古的读者阅读。
items.title: Tracking individual dietary choices in complex past food webs: Integrated bulk collagen and compound-specific stable isotope analysis of urban cats

items.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Land snails can be utilized to infer paleoclimate variability due to the preservation and incorporation of stable isotopes in their aragonite shells (δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O
                    <jats:sub>shell</jats:sub>
                    and δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C
                    <jats:sub>shell</jats:sub>
                    ). A
                    <jats:italic toggle="yes">Figuladra bayensis</jats:italic>
                    (Biggenden Banded Snail) shell was collected shortly after death from Coalstoun Lakes National Park (CLNP), Queensland, Australia to investigate if this species is suitable for paleoclimate investigations. A total of 200 samples were collected for δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O
                    <jats:sub>shell</jats:sub>
                    and δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C
                    <jats:sub>shell</jats:sub>
                    analyses and additional eight radiocarbon (
                    <jats:sup>14</jats:sup>
                    C) dating samples were collected along the shell’s growth axis from the apex to the aperture (234 mm) from one typical modern (recently dead) specimen. Results indicate that the Biggenden Banded Snail lived approximately 4.5 years with “step-like” shell growth rates between 23.7 and 144.3 mm yr
                    <jats:sup>−1</jats:sup>
                    . Our
                    <jats:sup>14</jats:sup>
                    C ages permit the record to be tied to observed extreme rain events (i.e. ex-tropical cyclones) without inferring time-based growth intervals or isotopic fluctuations alone. The δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O
                    <jats:sub>shell</jats:sub>
                    values depict seasonal variability with a rapid decrease immediately after large precipitation events, followed by more gradual increases in δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O
                    <jats:sub>shell</jats:sub>
                    as conditions dry. In contrast, the δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C
                    <jats:sub>shell</jats:sub>
                    record reflects variability in the snail’s C
                    <jats:sub>3</jats:sub>
                    diet with the seasons and as the specimen matures. The one exception to this pattern is the one large decrease during a phase of higher moisture and warmer temperature that may be related to snail reproduction. The development of an event-informed interpretive age-growth model constrained using multiple
                    <jats:sup>14</jats:sup>
                    C measurements along the growth axis represents an important innovation in snail isotope studies. This work establishes the first Biggenden Banded Snail isotope time-series while improving our understanding of the general relationships between land snail shell stable isotope records and climate.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《利用稳定同位素与碳十四测年评估澳大利亚昆士兰东南部比根登带纹蜗牛作为气候档案的潜力》：研究以一只新近死亡的比根登带纹蜗牛为对象，沿其234毫米生长轴采集200个稳定同位素样品和8个碳十四测年样品，重建其约4.5年的生长历史，并将同位素记录与极端降雨事件对应，提出基于事件的年龄—生长解释模型，为陆地蜗牛同位素古气候研究提供了新思路。
items.title: Evaluating the Biggenden Banded Snail ( Figuladra bayensis ) as a climate archive for SE Queensland, Australia, using stable isotopes and 14 C dating

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Technological complexity has been a continuous trope in archaeological research from its beginnings in the nineteenth century. Based on a concept of unidirectional cultural evolution, archaeological material was ordered along a linear progression from simple to complex. While creating hierarchies of extant populations based on the complexity of their tools is not overtly practiced in archaeology anymore, the same is not true for the deep past. The concept of behavioural modernity and research on human cognitive evolution is still partly founded on technological complexity. The turn away from technological complexity to symbolic behaviour in pursuing questions surrounding behavioural modernity and humanness was less a reaction to criticisms of the concept but served to maintain the hierarchical ranking between modern humans and extinct hominins. Here, we propose an alternative view on technological complexity that attempts to overcome linear hierarchies and lingering progressivist notions. By reviewing several measures of complexity alongside their analytical units and underlying definitions, we show that technological complexity is not suitable for creating a single hierarchy of artefacts, assemblages, or hominin species. The multitude of existing definitions, methods, and measures does not imply a fundamental flaw in these approaches but exemplifies the multidimensionality of technological complexity. We propose a new way of understanding multiple, justified measures for technological complexity through a heterarchical structure that allows various kinds of ranking to exist depending on context, need, scale, or function, including the potential for competing or even contradictory hierarchies. A heterarchical perspective on technological complexity asks ‘How were technologies or hominins complex?’ rather than ‘How complex were technologies and hominins relative to another?’ This approach can shed persistent historical bias and overcome simplistic dichotomies such as ‘us’ and ‘them’ in deep-time archaeology that hinder our ability to engage with questions about the becoming of humans in a meaningful way.</jats:p>
items.summary: 《考古学中的风吹落叶——人类起源研究中技术复杂性的多维性》：文章梳理技术复杂性概念在考古学中的演变，指出其线性进步观仍潜藏于行为现代性与人类认知演化研究，并通过比较多种复杂性的定义与测量，主张以异层级结构理解不同情境下的多元排序，值得关注人类起源叙事如何摆脱“我们”与“他们”的二分。
items.title: Blowing Leaves in Archaeology—The Multidimensionality of Technological Complexity in Human Origins Research
items.venue: Journal of Archaeological Method and Theory

items.summary: 《尼安德特人之前的意大利：早期人类的文化路径》：论文梳理了尼安德特人之前意大利早期人类的文化发展脉络，涉及相关考古遗址与石器工业的演变。对关注旧石器时代早期人类行为与文化演化的读者，这篇多作者合作研究提供了意大利地区的具体证据与框架。
items.title: Italy before the Neanderthals: Cultural pathways of early humans
